from itertools import permutations

# Each expert speaks their native language and the foreign languages stated.
languages = {
    "South Korea": {"Korean"},
    "France": {"French", "German"},
    "Britain": {"English", "Korean"},
    "Germany": {"German", "French", "English", "Korean"},
}

options = {
    "A": ("Britain", "Germany", "South Korea", "France"),
    "B": ("France", "Britain", "Germany", "South Korea"),
    "C": ("Germany", "Britain", "France", "South Korea"),
    "D": ("Germany", "Britain", "South Korea", "France"),
}

def evaluate(order):
    room = {person: i + 1 for i, person in enumerate(order)}
    communicating_neighbors = {person: [] for person in order}

    # Rooms on the same side form the adjacency path 1--2--3--4.
    for left, right in zip(order, order[1:]):
        if languages[left] & languages[right]:
            communicating_neighbors[left].append(right)
            communicating_neighbors[right].append(left)

    conditions = {
        "Korean room number exceeds German room number":
            room["South Korea"] > room["Germany"],
        "Korean cannot communicate with any neighbor":
            len(communicating_neighbors["South Korea"]) == 0,
        "French cannot communicate with any neighbor":
            len(communicating_neighbors["France"]) == 0,
        "British can communicate with exactly one neighbor":
            len(communicating_neighbors["Britain"]) == 1,
    }
    return conditions, communicating_neighbors

valid_orders = []
for order in permutations(languages):
    conditions, _ = evaluate(order)
    if all(conditions.values()):
        valid_orders.append(order)

print("Exhaustive search: all 24 room assignments.")
print("Valid assignments:", valid_orders)

correct_options = []
for label, order in options.items():
    conditions, _ = evaluate(order)
    valid = all(conditions.values())
    print(f"Option {label}: {'valid' if valid else 'invalid'}")
    if valid:
        correct_options.append(label)

submitted = "D"
conditions, neighbors = evaluate(options[submitted])
print("Submitted order:", options[submitted])
print("Korean's communicating neighbors:", neighbors["South Korea"])
print("Failed conditions:", [name for name, holds in conditions.items() if not holds])
print("Expected option(s):", ", ".join(correct_options) or "none")

if len(valid_orders) == 1 and len(correct_options) == 1:
    print("CHECK PASS" if submitted == correct_options[0] else "CHECK FAIL")
else:
    print("UNSUPPORTED")
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
